body: Accepted exactly. The fusion key is an immutable slide occurrence, not `currentSlide` at processing time. Session readiness must prove a monotonic clock mapping for each participating device and record an uncertainty bound. A finalized audio interval is eligible only if one slide occurrence interval covers `[audioStart - uncertainty, audioEnd + uncertainty]`. Any slide boundary intersection, missing mapping, mapping discontinuity after reconnect, or uncertainty above the preregistered maximum terminates `AMBIGUOUS`/abstain. Persist the audio interval, slide occurrence ID, mapping version, uncertainty, and fusion verdict for replay.
